notes:
Broad locator covers two suboutcomes; retained authors printed aggregate effect from Table 1. No p printed for this aggregate; individual suboutcome p-values were not paired with the aggregate. Primary workbook rows 99,100: Coping: Active coping [ReplicationEffect=-0.16436050245900666, ReplicationPValue=1.431588652302283e-10]; Coping: Avoidant coping [ReplicationEffect=0.2543389867909853, ReplicationPValue=1.2367021911449067e-23]. Original-source rule applied: replication project citations/quoted original statistics were not substituted for original primary evidence. DOI landing 403; Unpaywall closed with no OA location; OpenAlex no PDF; author lab publications page and title searches yielded no target full paper.
Source follow-up: Published article title and authors match the supplied reference. PDF page 7 (printed p. 995), Table 2, visually checked against the supplied scan. The table is titled "Standardized Parameter Estimates of Structural Model 1: Paths From the Personality Predispositions to the Coping Factors". Its three outcome columns are "Avoidant Coping", "Active Coping", and "Seeking Support". These are standardized structural-model path estimates, not printed Pearson r values. The supplied locator does not specify which coping factor or test to select. No coefficient was selected or converted. Contextual sample only: printed p. 992, Response Rates, states "The final sample for the analysis of coping and psychological adjustment consisted of 672 respondents who had completed both questionnaires"; student identification numbers were verified, two incomplete/improper Time 2 questionnaires were dropped, and missing scale/item values were imputed as described in Analysis. This sample cannot establish a uniquely specified target test. Source text: /home/lukas/.t3/worktrees/fred-data/audit-fred-stats-2026-10/audit/fred_stats_2026-10/texts/followup_mac_b9278a81662a16a18732b789.txt; numerical visual check: /home/lukas/work/fred-mac-recovery-20261030/private_batch_01/artifacts/b9278a81662a16a18732b789_ebsco_psycinfo.pdf. The target names negative emotionality. The located predictor is "Negative mood", measured with the Affects Balance Scale (printed p. 991), rather than an explicitly named negative-emotionality trait scale. Table 2 has three possible outcomes: its "Negative mood" row prints ".30***", ".16**", and ".20***" in the Avoidant Coping, Active Coping, and Seeking Support columns, respectively. The footnote prints "** p < .01. *** p < .001." The description "Coping in relation to negative emotionality" and p. 7 locator do not identify one of these tests. No arbitrary choice among them was made. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
